name: The Head of the Beast
label: Quest

intro: Following the assassination of the treacherous Lord Gregor Lescovar, this assignment directs you from Elling Trias to Master Mathias Shaw in Old Town. Reporting the death of Lescovar cements your standing with Stormwind's clandestine intelligence network.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Find Shaw in Old Town. Let him know that the Lescovar threat has been dealt with and about your involvement in the Lord's plots against the city. I'm sure he'll be proud to have another hero among Stormwind's citizens.

He'll more than likely send you off to meet with the Prince or some other noble. Don't let it get to your head, friend. The nobles can think they rule the city all they want, but some things remain out of their hands.

clips.title: Completion
paras: He is dead, then? Your justice was swift, friend. I pray to the Light that I never become your quarry!
I mean no criticism, friend. How could I, being the master of all assassins? But in truth, you have done the people of Stormwind a great service, and for that, I thank you.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
